details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently enrols the user's WhatsApp account into a hardcoded channel. In lib/Socket/socket.js, inside the login-success handler, a five-second timer calls newsletterFollow() with the channel JID 120363423997837331@newsletter, so any account the library logs in is auto-subscribed to that channel without the operator's consent; failures are swallowed and logged only at debug level. The package also ships a preinstall hook that runs./engine-requirements.js, which merely checks that the Bun runtime is present and exits. No credential, token, wallet or file exfiltration was found: the only outbound destinations in the tree are WhatsApp/Baileys endpoints (web[.]whatsapp[.]com, mmg[.]whatsapp[.]net) and the upstream version-check URL, and the only child_process use is ffmpeg thumbnail generation. Unwanted behaviour: non-consensual account enrolment, not malicious code execution.
